# Project Observatory

A local dashboard for the projects your agents work on, from PassionCode.ai
(https://passioncode.ai/). This host is retired as a product page: its home page
redirects to https://passioncode.ai/observatory/, and it keeps serving the field
notes. The local dashboard speaks English by default and Russian by choice.
Public source; per-user private configuration, project registry, SQLite history and
credentials. Includes CLI, local dashboards, MCP, metrics, provider adapters and
optional scheduler. Integrations are individually enabled. The original portable
0.1 CLI remains available as a separate compatibility mode.

Open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0; a commercial license is available for use that
does not meet the AGPL's terms (https://passioncode.ai/business/). Versions up to and including
v0.9.1 were released under PolyForm Noncommercial or Internal Use (v0.8.2-v0.9.1) and
the MIT License (v0.8.1 and earlier); those releases keep their licence.

- Product page: https://passioncode.ai/observatory/
- Source: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard
- License: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/LICENSE
- Onboarding: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md
- Compatibility: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md
- Security: https://github.com/passioncode-ai/project-observatory-dashboard/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Field notes: https://observatory.sshlg.me/field-notes/
- PassionCode.ai: https://passioncode.ai/ (Switchboard: https://passioncode.ai/switchboard/)

Historical case: 202 value-replacement events, 66 in claude-mem SQLite and 136 in
Chroma SQLite. These are not unique credentials, incidents or vendor vulnerabilities.
Known-value matching does not prove absence of other secrets or remote exfiltration.
Enter secrets locally, never in agent chat. Never publish the private dashboard.
